title: acalypha macrostachya f. macrophylla
intro: Acalypha macrostachya f. macrophylla, commonly known as the large-stalked copperleaf, is a plant species within the family Euphorbiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may help to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. Further research is needed to fully elucidate the bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of Acalypha macrostachya f. macrophylla.
